entries.text: You cannot sleep in such a dreadful place.
A shiver runs down your spine.
You are haunted by nightmares.
Something is breathing in the dark beside you.
The shadows here are deeper than they should be.
You hear footsteps that are not your own.
Sleep will not save you tonight.
The walls remember everything that happened here.
Do not look under the bed.
Your torch went dark on its own.
The silence in this room is listening.
You feel cold fingers brush your shoulder.
Every door you closed is open again.
The night is longer than it was yesterday.
You are not alone in this room.
Close your eyes. It is already closer.
The floor creaks under a weight that is not there.
You have dreamed this exact moment before.
Something whispered your name from the corner.
The dark is patient. It has waited a long time for you.
Make your resting place safer, while you still can.
The cold that woke you did not come from outside.
Phantoms can smell how long it has been since you slept.
The longer you stay awake, the more of them gather.
Every villager you ever lost still remembers your face.
The light from your torch does not reach as far as it used to.
It has been counting your heartbeats since you lay down.
You were followed home. It is still waiting outside.
What sleeps in the deep dark does not need eyes to find you.
You hear something digging beneath the floor.
The reflection in the water did not move when you did.
There were footprints leading to your bed, and none leading away.
When you wake, count the windows. There will be one too many.
Do not answer if it knocks three times.
It learned to smile by watching you.
The last thing you see will look just like home.
You will wake up. It will simply not let you leave.
There is no morning at the bottom of this dream.
